Third-party coding agents installed locally (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Kimi, Kilocode or a custom command) that DevoxxGenie launches as child processes, either as one-shot CLI runs or as Agent Client Protocol (ACP) sessions.
